domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract document was retrievable (zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down for the whole session). Only company self-declaration found, on https://www.fena.com/ : "Fena has a widespread distribution network with over 4500 distributors, ensuring our product presence in maximum retail stores across India" and "Fena's own 8 Manufacturing Facilities". This is a website claim, therefore status = declared_only, not confirmed.
note: Legal entity verified as existing and active: registered office "Fena Private Limited, A-237, Okhla Industrial Area, Phase I, New Delhi-110020, India, CIN Number- U74899DL1986PTC025829" (from fena.com footer). Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs records with destination and HS code — not merely claimed: detergent powder HS 34029011 to Nepal (Biratnagar, via Jogbani land port) and to UAE (Umm Al Qaiwain, via Nhava Sheva) in Jan–Feb 2026, plus a 2026-02-17/2026-02-04 import of Linear Alkyl Benzene (HS 38170011) from Qatar Energy Marketing via Mundra, i.e. the company is a real manufacturer importing raw material and exporting finished goods. HS note: declared HS 340250 does not match the observed 34029011 (detergent powder, other surface-active preparations) — per project rule this is NOT a rejection ground; the actual code is 34029011 and the record is kept with HS corrected. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in any source consulted, not estimated. Sanctions/litigation: not assessed in this role. All 10 name variants in the input resolve to the same single legal entity (Fena Private Limited, CIN U74899DL1986PTC025829); no separate 'Fena Ltd' entity was evidenced.
